features.claim: Removes Google web-service integration and blocks runtime requests to substituted Google domains (documented as domain substitution plus a request block).
Rewrites Google and other listed domains in the source tree to non-resolving names ending in qjz9zk before building.
Removes prebuilt binaries from the Chromium tree and replaces or rebuilds them where possible.
Optional switch --fingerprinting-client-rects-noise scales getClientRects()/getBoundingClientRect() by a per-document random factor; the project describes it as disabled unless requested.
Optional switch --fingerprinting-canvas-image-data-noise perturbs at most a small number of pixels in canvas image data readbacks.
Optional switch --fingerprinting-canvas-measuretext-noise scales CanvasRenderingContext2D.measureText() output by a small random factor per document.
Disables the intranet redirect detector, which the README identifies as the source of extraneous DNS requests.
Optional switch --disable-grease-tls removes TLS GREASE values; the flag list pairs it with an Accept header override for a non-Chromium TLS/HTTP profile.
Disables Safe Browsing as part of removing Google service integration; the project documents the tradeoff in its FAQ.
Optional switch --disable-search-engine-collection stops automatic search-engine scraping from pages.
Optional switch --max-connections-per-host sets a 6 or 15 connection cap per host.
Optional switch --force-punycode-hostnames converts all internationalized domain names to punycode.

features.claim: Enables Canvas and Rect API fingerprinting mitigations by default.
Enables AudioBuffer and AnalyserNode fingerprinting mitigations.
Disables WebGL by default.
Disables WebGPU by default.
Disables WebRTC by default and documents that local IP addresses are not exposed.
Disables the Client Hints API and UA full-version / getHighEntropyValues() exposure.
Allows a custom timezone or a random timezone instead of the host timezone.
Overrides navigator.language and overrides navigator.connection information.
Overrides device memory and CPU concurrency values.
Partitions cookies and storage by top frame domain and enables third-party storage partitioning.
Disables SameSite=None cookies in A/B/A cross-site contexts, documented as a Firefox-style mitigation.
Disables TLS resumption, citing linkability concerns.
Documents hardening against incognito-mode detection.
Enables a desktop Keyboard Layout API mitigation.
Adds an always-incognito mode preference that launches new tabs and clicked links as incognito.
Adds a proxy configuration page supporting PAC URLs, automatic configuration and explicit proxy settings.

sources.sourceAvailability: patch set plus Android build arguments; depends on GrapheneOS OS hardening

No Android device was used, so no behaviour was measured.

features.claim: Enables hardware memory tagging (MTE) for the main allocator on supported devices.
Builds with type-based Control Flow Integrity and strong stack protection.
JavaScript JIT is disabled by default with a per-site toggle.
Enables the DrumBrake WebAssembly interpreter so WebAssembly works with the JIT disabled.
Blocks dynamic code execution for processes without the JavaScript JIT as a seccomp-bpf extension.
WebGPU is disabled to reduce attack surface.
Provides a WebRTC IP handling policy toggle and defaults to the most private policy.
Ships a per-site content filtering engine using EasyList, EasyPrivacy and regional lists.
Applies the reduced user-agent and replaces high-entropy client hints with placeholders for browser and WebView.
Disables seed-based field trials and variations fetching.
Battery API always reports charging at 100%.
Enables more complete state partitioning without an origin-trial opt-out.
Makes HTTPS-only mode the default.
Disables third-party cookies by default.
Disables sensor access by default.
